It has little pockets; it can be served with syrup; the pockets are always cut by hand.
Its beans are roasted; it can be served cold; it is always brewed with milk.
It has flaky layers; it can be shaped like a crescent; it gets its layers by boiling the dough.
It can be made in a pot; people often add salt after cooking; it has to be served hot.
It can melt in your hand; some versions are bitter; it takes its color from roasted coffee.
It softens as it warms; it can be served in a cone; every flavor contains eggs.
It can be baked in layers; it can be decorated after cooling; it can only be made in a round pan.
It can have a soft shell; people can fill it with vegetables; the outer shell has to be sliced from a loaf.
It can be steamed; some versions are filled with meat; every version has to be sweet.
It can be toasted; it can have layers of vegetables; the bread always has to stay in one piece.
It usually includes seasoned rice; some pieces are rolled around a filling; every piece must contain raw fish.
It can grow long ears; its hind legs help it jump; its front teeth stop growing when it becomes an adult.
It can have a bushy tail; it can live near towns; it hunts mainly by swinging from trees.
It often begins life in water; many can jump; adult ones are covered in feathers.
Some climb trees; some eat berries; all species live in groups throughout the year.
It breathes air; some live in groups; it uses gills to breathe underwater.
It comes to the surface for air; some species sing; members of every species have teeth.
It can spend time on land; it lays eggs; it chews plants with flat molars.
It has a shell; some species live in the sea; it can step out of its shell when it grows.
It can use its nose to pick things up; some have tusks; it sheds its tusks every year.
It can reach high branches; its coat has patches; it grows a set of branching antlers each year.
It has stripes; it can live in herds; its young hatch from eggs.
It can roar; some adults grow a mane; it cannot live alongside others of its kind.
